prompt: You're pairing with a candidate on a ride-hailing backend. Drivers ping their GPS position every few seconds, and `DriverLocationService` writes each ping straight into a Redis GEO set so riders can look up nearby cars — the writes never throw, Redis reports the GEO set growing, and there are no errors anywhere in the logs. Yet the rider-facing "find nearby drivers" endpoint returns an empty list for every rider, everywhere, all the time. Walk through the code below, explain why nearby search is always empty even though drivers are actively reporting positions, and then describe how you'd fix it structurally (not just at one call site).
